messages.subject: Meridian - Sentvia's v2 redline reviewed
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Reviewed Ashworth's v2. Good news: they've accepted 24-hour breach notification and the 90-day export right. On liability they've gone 100%/150% and bumped the uplift cap to 6%. I'd counter at 125% general cap (keep their 150% super-cap), and reject the 6% - hold at 5%. Our v3 counter-redline is ready.

Best,
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0137

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
